component.name: LibreSprite
component.summary: Animated sprite editor and pixel art tool

description.p: LibreSprite lets you create 2D animations for videogames. From sprites, to pixel-art, retro style graphics, and whatever you like about the 8-bit (and 16-bit) era.

ul.li: Multiple sprites can be edited at once
Ready to use palettes, or make your own
Sprites are composed of both layers & frames
Tiled drawing mode, useful to draw patterns and textures
Pixel precise tools like filled contour, polygon, shading mode, etc.
Several file types supported for your sprites and animations
This is a community package: it installs the official Linux AppImage from the LibreSprite releases unmodified, and follows new releases automatically.

The application opens and saves files through its own built-in file browser, which the desktop portal cannot mediate. The package grants read-write access to your Pictures folder, and on first run points the save dialog there; files saved anywhere else are not kept after the application exits. Enable more folders with "flatpak override":
Your Documents folder: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-documents io.github.libresprite.libresprite
Any other folder: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/dir io.github.libresprite.libresprite
Undo all of these: flatpak override --user --reset io.github.libresprite.libresprite
The package carries the official AppImage only; the AppStream data and desktop entry on this page come from the packaging.
